column1: # TIME-based SNOBOL4 benchmarks -- MEASURED run-to-run noise floor
#   MACHINE LOAD AT BAKE: nproc=16 loadavg=0.64 0.73 0.91
#   ⛔ THE FLOOR IS A PROPERTY OF MACHINE LOAD, NOT ONLY OF THE ENGINE (s200).  The 2026-08-20 bake ran
#   while EIGHT fleet seats shared this box and its min_detectable reached 47.9% -- a floor that wide
#   cannot see a 1.4x regression.  A solo re-bake of the SAME binaries moved sbl +20.9% and m3 +13.0%,
#   i.e. the shift was LOAD, not the engine and not the oracle flag: -b vs -bf measured back-to-back on a
#   quiet box is -0.3% (+/-2.6%), ZERO.  ⛔ NEVER compare a floor baked under load with one baked solo.
# SCRIP_NOHUGE=1  SCRIP_HEAP_MB=1024  (arena sized past the window so no
#   collection fires inside it -- a GC row measures an ~835ms stall, not dispersion)
# ⛔ THE ALLOCATING ROWS' DISPERSION WAS THE GC STALL LOTTERY, NOT THP (BM-3 correction):
#   whether an ~835ms regeneration lands inside the window is a coin flip, and it was being
#   baked as variance.  GC-free, table_access m3 goes cv 12.4%->1.9% and array_sum 10.9%->0.5%.
# min_detectable_pct = 3*cv; a single-run delta smaller than this is WEATHER.
